items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions: 'you guys came by and Jimmy played for us, and Eubie Blake and who else...'

ctx.x: No, this is the New Orleans Jazz Festival, but George Wein brings a lot of people and I don't know if he handles the whole festival. I don't think so.

But this is marvelous, you're down here, I saw so many wonderful people last night. We opened here last night in the Hyatt House, and you guys came by and Jimmy played for us, and Eubie Blake and who else, Illionois Jacquet, Lionel Hampton. It was quite some opening night, Eddie B&G. George Wein even played. So we thought we'd take this opportunity, Jimmy, just you and I to continue our history, which we started in New York City, this is the last portion of it. And I'd like to get into some of the things you were…
